description:
Overview 
 We are looking for a SAS member for the Network Device team to support development of new and existing capabilities. Join a mission-driven team developing advanced software capabilities in direct support of U.S. national security initiatives. As a CNO Engineer on the SAS Mobile team, you’ll play a critical role designing, developing, and deploying tools that enhance mission’s ability to operate and defend across cyber and communications domains.
 This position is ideal for engineers who thrive in challenging environments where innovation, precision, and impact intersect.
 
 
 Requirements 
 The years of experience must be in software development or an extremely related discipline.
 This LCAT also requires 2 years of cybersecurity/CNO-specific development.
 The candidate's degree must be in Computer Science or Computer Engineering (or something extremely similar)
 5+ years of experience with C development and reverse engineering (CS2)
 10+ years of experience with C development and reverse engineering (CS3)
 Experience with CNO Development on Network Devices
 Candidates should have one of more of the following:
 ​In-depth understanding of network protocols ​
 Experience with network device appliances (routers, switches, firewalls)
 Experience working in a Real Time Operating System environment
 
 Benefits 
 401K: up to 3% discretionary profit sharing contribution + 100% match on the 1st 7% of pay
 PTO: 20 days per year
 Healthcare, dental, vision, Free for a single participant
 $50,000 Life insurance provided, additional voluntary life insurance available
 
 InterImage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. InterImage provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
